text:
Minh Tran: heads up — I found a measurable quality regression when comparing q4b-quant-v2 against the baseline on the current seedbank tranche we use for benchmarking. Before we roll any relabel or rerun evals, we should rebalance the seedbank and run an overlap audit across recent cohorts.

Minh Tran: concrete asks: 1) overlap % between new-samples (last 30d) and seedbank; 2) dedupe fingerprint threshold to use for this sweep; 3) a stratified resample plan that keeps difficult buckets untouched.

Sophie Li: noted. can you paste the failing eval sample or a couple examples? helps me surface what "regression" looks like in practice. :eyes:

Minh Tran: pasted two snippets inline: "Q: summarize policy for returns" -> v2 hallucinated policy clause; baseline correctly deferred. and "code patch intent" where v2 dropped a required safety check. will DM exact rows to labelers.

Ara Gomez: I can run overlap scan now. using the canonical fingerprint (sha256 of normalized prompt). proposed query:

```
SELECT f.fingerprint, count(*) as occurrences
FROM seedbank_samples s
JOIN generated_samples g ON s.fingerprint = g.fingerprint
WHERE g.cohort_ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY f.fingerprint
ORDER BY occurrences desc
LIMIT 100;
```

Ara Gomez: thinking dedupe threshold = 0.98 sim on normalized tokens (we've used 0.97 before, but that flagged a lot of near-duplicates). ok to try 0.98?

Jamal Patel: tagging labeling capacity — we have 6 active labelers this sprint, can absorb ~1.2k relabel items over 3 days if we prioritize the top-entropy bucket. recommend we surface high-entropy items first.

Sophie Li: suggested resample: keep the top 5% hardest examples (by disagreement score) fixed, then proportional resample the rest from stratified cohorts (intent-type, lang, length). that should preserve difficult cases for regression detection.

Dev Curation Bot: overlap-scan job started (job_id=curation-2798765432-1). ETA ~ 10m. Results will be posted to #eng-ml in thread.

Ara Gomez: quick update — initial overlap results: raw dedupe rate ~18% between 30d cohort and seedbank (fingerprint exact match). Near-duplicate cluster estimate at 0.98 sim ≈ 24% additional.

Ara Gomez: next steps I propose: 1) run candidate purge for exact dupes (18%) and mark near-duplicates for manual review (24%); 2) create stratified resample manifest with seedbank size preserved by bucket; 3) hand top-2k high-entropy items to labelers with instructions.

Minh Tran: sounds good. Sophie/Jamal — can you confirm labeling instructions and SLAs? Sophie, please produce the stratified manifest by EOD. Jamal, can you confirm labeler queue assignment and estimated completion?

Sophie Li: will do. I'll freeze the schema for labels (intent/safety/accuracy) and post manifest link here by 18:00 PT.

Jamal Patel: assigned. I'll split queue into 3 reviewers per item for consensus and give labelers a quick calibration doc. target done by Thu COB.

Minh Tran: thanks — we'll hold any quant evaluation reruns until we have relabel results. I'll open a small canary eval after relabel to verify fixes. :thumbsup:

Dev Curation Bot: job complete. overlap-scan summary: exact_matches=1834, near_duplicate_clusters=2431, total_seedbank_size=10234. full CSV uploaded: https://internal/redwood/curation/2798765432/overlap.csv

Ara Gomez: uploaded a short notebook with cluster sampling heuristics: https://internal/redwood/curation/notebooks/seedbank-cluster-sample.ipynb

Sophie Li: got the manifest, looks good. adding calibration examples now.

Minh Tran: great progress — keeping this thread as the single source for coordination. will post follow-ups after the relabel canary.
